processes.name: Real-time desk standing instructions broadcast to shift group
processes.description: The Portland real-time desk lead emails the whole shift group rules and market changes (tag numbers, adjustment bid limits, Enpower/CAPS entry, BPA prices, counterparty approvals, new scheduling IDs). Each is a manual broadcast, often a forward with the attachment re-sent separately.
processes.stall_points: Attachments are sent in a second email (the Enpower memo went out without its attachment). The same notice is re-forwarded weeks later (Allegheny SCID on 10/01 and again 11/21).
processes.automation: Publish desk rules and counterparty or price changes on one shared page or distribution tool with acknowledgement tracking, rather than ad hoc emails.

processes.name: Short/long position hand-off to real-time shift
processes.description: Prescheduling and cash desks email the real-time shift distribution list that the book is long or short at a hub for a given day, with deal numbers. Real time must then buy or sell to fill, and the desk lead relays or acknowledges.
processes.stall_points: Notices arrive late or with little notice (a long position emailed at 1:30 for the next day), and are relayed manually to the group.
processes.automation: Show prescheduled positions and linked deal numbers directly in the position manager, with an alert instead of an email.

processes.name: Shift schedule changes and weekend coverage coordination
processes.description: The desk lead distributes the monthly shift schedule and arranges extra coverage (Enron Canada weekend desk, training slots). Staff swap days by email and must report changes to the leads and mark the schedule.
processes.stall_points: Swaps depend on people emailing the leads and hand-marking the schedule. Coverage details arrive in several forwards and attachments.
processes.automation: A shared schedule tool with swap requests and automatic notification.

evidence.quote: Please send Bert and I an email notifying us of the changes and be sure to write your changes on the schedule.

processes.name: Real-time deal documentation and dispute/revenue reconciliation
processes.description: Real-time staff reconstruct what happened on specific hours (resupply cuts, wheels missing from the inc sheet, a net-scheduling problem) and write it up for settlements, counterparties or the CAISO. Disputes arise because changes are not documented when made.
processes.stall_points: About 30 disputes came from the first two days of EOL because deals were altered or zeroed with no notes. Missing inc-sheet entries are found only later against CAISO finals.
processes.automation: Require a reason field on any deal alteration, and auto-compare the inc sheet to CAISO awards to flag missing deals.

evidence.quote: We have already received approximately 30 disputes filed by various counterparties regarding deals that flowed on the 20th and 21st.

processes.name: Group cell phone bill and cost review
processes.description: The desk lead and an admin trace monthly AT&T charges, set per-employee caps and per-person plans, and send usage emails to each member. Numbers are assembled by hand from bills.
processes.stall_points: Cost breakdown by person and by new phones needs going through all the bills by hand. Plan changes get reverted by the carrier rep.
processes.automation: Pull carrier billing data into a per-user usage report that is sent automatically.

processes.name: Misdirected mail from name collision and unwanted access requests
processes.description: Bill Williams III (trading) repeatedly receives mail meant for Bill Williams in Technical Assets (Longview project) or for security administrators. He forwards or replies asking to be removed and corrects the sender's lists.
processes.stall_points: Senders keep using the wrong address, and each misroute needs a manual reply or forward. Removal requests are repeated.
processes.automation: Fix the distribution lists and directory entries once, and route security access requests only to the approvers.

evidence.quote: I think you intended to send this to Bill Williams in Technical Assets. Please note the difference in addresses and make the change.

Please remove my name from whatever list you might have. I work in Portland and am not involved with security clearance or security access.
I am not involved with security, in Houston or otherwise, and can not help you obtain a security badge.

processes.name: Gas logistics path and contract issue resolution
processes.description: Logistics staff chase unresolved path or contract problems on past months with the deal owner by email. They also gather desk feedback on the Path Manager system.
processes.stall_points: Missing paths are found after the month is closed and need the original trader to explain. Feedback is gathered through long reply-all chains, each colour-coding comments.
processes.automation: Auto-flag deliveries without a path and route them with deal context to the owner. Collect system feedback in a structured form.

processes.name: Collecting desk inputs for logistics reports and presentations
processes.description: Logistics admins ask every desk for inputs for a shared presentation or schedule, then send reminders and redistribute the final version.
processes.stall_points: Needs a reminder before the deadline. Revised schedules are sent with requests to forward to people missed on the list.
processes.automation: A shared document with per-desk owners and automatic deadline reminders.
